reportedSymptoms: trunk-like cliff columns rendered along ordinary grass/sand coastline
runtime attempted to load obsolete generated terrain, object, tree, world-paint, and HUD paths
asset-pack discovery reported one opaque failure without naming the manifest

rootCause.cliffs: The packaged OGA source is a valid 384x288 connected-art sheet, but the temporary renderer misclassified the isolated grass-top pillar rows as a repeatable terrain cliff-face module.
rootCause.assets: Several production pack manifests still referenced deleted pre-normalization generated outputs and legacy HUD filenames.
rootCause.collision: Smooth geology was still eligible to create structure beneath general land materials; only explicit highland materials should participate before native-editor elevation authoring is complete.

cliffWorkflow: select connected components rather than assumed cells
tag top caps, faces, corners, ends, ramps, ladders, bridges, cave mouths, and water-facing variants
publish only after source bounds, collision, and traversal previews pass
